content: How to Structure and Maximize Value Across 3 Member Tiers Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000106349 Brilliant Directories Membership Plan Guide This guide presents a recommended structure for organizing members into three key plans—Basic, Premium, and Elite—using the built-in features from the Brilliant Directories platform. The goal is to maximize visibility, engagement, and upgrade incentives through clearly defined benefits at each plan. Basic Member Plan This plan is designed to introduce new users to the directory by offering limited features and visibility. It is suitable for free members or those trying out the platform for the first time. Public directory listing with limited visibility Basic profile with logo, short bio, and contact form Limited posting (e.g., 1 listing or article) Access to dashboard with limited features Appear in search results below paid members Read-only access to public content Limited lead notifications or delayed leads Upgrade opportunities for increased exposure Premium Member Plan This plan provides increased visibility and engagement tools. It is suited for professionals or small businesses looking to enhance their presence and lead generation. Higher search placement and featured listing badge SEO friendly custom profile URL Full media uploads (images, video, social links) Unlimited listings, events, and content posts Receive instant leads and inquiries Enable call to action buttons (contact, book, message) Access members-only resources and downloads Add testimonials, services, or pricing details Custom profile layout and branding options Elite Member Tier This top-tier membership offers the highest level of visibility, exclusive features, and support. It is intended for verified professionals or organizations requiring premium exposure. Top placement in all search results Verified or Pro badge on the profile Featured placement on homepage and newsletters Unlimited content posting across all categories Priority or exclusive leads Analytics dashboard for profile views and lead tracking Ad-free profile page Custom profile design and layout Ability to add team members under one account Personal support and recognition features Customizing This Framework Use these three membership tiers as a flexible starting point. Adjust pricing, visibility, and access based on the needs of the target audience or niche. Encourage upgrades by clearly communicating the added value of each plan and by showing examples of premium features in use.
